newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources offers to buy U.S. Diagnostic.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources offers to buy U.S. Diagnostic.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Thursday it had offered to buy U.S. Diagnostic Inc, a physician practice management provider.
The company said the merger deal would give U.S. Diagnostic $6.25 per share payable in Medical Resources common stock.
Farrell said he had not heard word from Diagnostic since the release of the company's statement.
Diagnostic has more than 13.6 million shares in circulation.
Diagnostic officials were not immediately available for comment.
On Thursday, the Nasdaq halted trading in Diagnostic's stock with the last sale at 5-3/4.
Medical Resources, which owns more than 60 centers, bought another one in Rancho Cucamonga, Calif., last month.
On March 19, it reported revenues of $32.2 million for the fourth quarter against $13.7 million a year ago.
